title: Bug: test_route_flap.py fails due to not waiting enough for route announcement
author: kalash-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

test_route_flap.py checks for routes to be announced and withdrawn after waiting for 1 sec, which makes it fail intermittently when route announcement/withdrawal takes more than 1 sec. I found that if we give a little more time, the waiting condition gets satisfied (i.e. route gets correctly announced). Replacing the 1 sec sleep with a wait_until condition with 20 sec timeout.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test_route_flap.py 

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expected behavior is for this test to pass consistently. Currently it fails for me most of the times due to above issue.

### Description of PR
`test_route_flap.py` checks for routes to be announced and withdrawn after waiting for 1 sec, which makes it fail intermittently when route announcement/withdrawal takes more than 1 sec. I found that if we give a little more time, the waiting condition gets satisfied (i.e. route gets correctly announced). Replacing the 1 sec sleep with a wait_until condition with 20 sec timeout.

Summary:
Fix `test_route_flap.py` by calling `check_route` in `wait_until` instead of a hard-coded 1 sec sleep
Fixes # (issue)
